merge_queue.note: Reported by .github/workflows/ci.yml jobs typescript, rust-check, and bundle-check on pull_request and merge_group.

promotion_model.build_once: cd-npm-cli.yml job stage and cd-pwa.yml job build upload the npm tree, Pages dist, and release metadata. Later jobs download those artifacts. CLI stage sets CLI_RELEASE_PACK=1 so esbuild omits sourcemaps, and prepare-cli-release deletes *.map files and excludes dist/**/*.map from the publish files list.
promotion_model.main_ci_gate: Before preview jobs, cd-main-ci-gate.mjs requires a successful ci.yml push on main for the same commit with TypeScript, Rust, and Bundle budgets all success. A cancelled run for that commit is non-terminal.
promotion_model.preview: After main CI passes, CLI and PWA jobs validate and pack their staged npm artifacts locally without registry credentials. The GitHub Pages deployment remains independent and runs after the existing build and profile proof.
promotion_model.preview_smoke: The CLI proof installs the staged tarball locally with scripts disabled and checks opensesame --version. PWA preview smoke verifies the deployed Pages bytes with Hurl and captures headless Chromium screenshots; it does not claim npm registry publication.
promotion_model.profile_proof: cd-pwa.yml keeps its full install profile proof, staged build, Pages deployment and live Pages verification. The npm package is checked locally.
promotion_model.production: The PWA job verifies the deployed Pages release after the existing gates. npm publication is disabled until a qualified immutable npm candidate and digest-bound promotion path exist.
promotion_model.failure: Any proof or Pages gate failure is reported by promotion_failed via cd-promotion-notify.mjs.
promotion_model.pages_split: github-pages is the live Pages deploy (actions/deploy-pages). It is not the Preview environment. deploy-pages preview:true is not available to the public, so there is no second Pages environment. Do not add required reviewers to github-pages.

github_environment_changes_via_gh.preview_required_reviewers: Review the protected environment before any future publication.
github_environment_changes_via_gh.production_required_reviewers: Do not weaken protection for a future npm publisher.
github_environment_changes_via_gh.github_pages: keep branch policy main only (rule 62085543). No required reviewers and no wait timer.
github_environment_changes_via_gh.npm_token: npm publication is disabled. Existing Preview or Production NPM_TOKEN secrets are not read by these workflows. Future candidate-bound publication requires independently configured trusted publishing or a protected fallback credential.

environments.name: Preview
environments.note: Historical npm environment; current package proof jobs do not use it or read NPM_TOKEN.

secrets.NPM_TOKEN: Historical npm credential; current proof jobs do not read it. Future OIDC publication requires a qualified candidate.
Historical npm credential; current workflows do not read it. Future OIDC publication requires a qualified candidate.

environments.name: github-pages
environments.role: Automatic live Pages deploy of the immutable artifact from cd-pwa.yml job deploy. Not the Preview environment. No second Preview Pages environment: actions/deploy-pages input preview is not public.

protection_rules.note: Do not add required reviewers. Production promotion is gated in workflow jobs, not by environment approval.

environments.name: copilot
environments.note: Existing environment; not referenced by new CD workflows. Reserved for Copilot/automation integrations.
